content.cafe: Two people sit across from each other at a cafe table, talking quietly over coffee. Then they stand up and walk out of the cafe together.

styles.nolan: In the style of a Christopher Nolan film.
styles.burton: In the style of a Tim Burton film.
styles.kubrick: In the style of a Stanley Kubrick film.
styles.wes_anderson: In the style of a Wes Anderson film.
styles.zhang_yimou: In the style of a Zhang Yimou film.
styles.spielberg: In the style of a Steven Spielberg film.

styles_desc.nolan: restrained natural cafe palette, side-window soft key with warm practicals, clean opposing staging at a small table, medium two-shot to wider exit shot, eye-level near-symmetrical composition, 35–50mm lens, smooth motivated dolly, naturalistic photochemical grade, firm contrast, fine grain, standard motion blur, 2 shots with a single straight cut on the stand.
styles_desc.burton: storybook Gothic cafe, warped dark-wood set, charcoal and dusty-blue palette, side-window key with warm practical fill, centered symmetrical staging breaking as they stand, medium-wide to full-figure low eye-level frames, 28–35mm lens, subtle push-in then restrained dolly drift, cool desaturated blue-gray grade, strong contrast, fine film grain, slight vignette, 3 clean straight-cut shots over 8 seconds.
styles_desc.kubrick: rigorous symmetrical cafe staging, muted cream brown and dull red palette, even side-window and hidden frontal fill, mirror-like blocking across a centered table, static frontal medium-wide at seated eye level, 28-35mm lens, restrained axial movement, neutral-cool photochemical grade, firm contrast, fine 35mm grain, deep focus, 24fps, two hard-cut shots.
styles_desc.wes_anderson: strict symmetry, centered cafe table and doorway, muted mustard teal cream palette, soft warm even frontal lighting, orderly staging, locked-off planimetric medium-wide then wider frontal full-body shot, 35mm lens, minimal movement, warm matte grade with lifted blacks and fine 35mm grain, crisp deadpan hard cut midway.
styles_desc.zhang_yimou: controlled warm-red and cream cafe palette, soft directional late-afternoon side light, balanced symmetrical staging, composed medium two-shot to wider exit shot, eye-level camera, 40-50mm lens, subtle smooth drift or track, rich disciplined color grading, medium-high contrast, fine film grain, fluid natural motion, two clean cuts only.
styles_desc.spielberg: warm wood-and-cream cafe, soft side-window key with practical amber fill and gentle back edge, balanced medium two-shot on 35-40mm at seated eye level, subtle push-in then smooth pan/boom to medium-wide as they stand and exit, restrained warm classical grade, moderate contrast, light film grain, smooth natural motion blur, 2 shots with one straight cut at the rise.
